features: DOES NOT CHANGE THE DATABASE SCHEMA AND REWRITES NO DATA — No migration. Plans already issued stay as they were, and transfers already recorded are not rewritten. The transfers you record from now on save a little more information in their record, which serves to state the figures per person: the plan rule for the end of a lease with a co-tenant who stays, what that rule leaves out of the pair, and, for the stops, each person's part and the share that sits in someone else's row; those already recorded do not have it, and where it is needed the program derives it from what their record says. The end of a lease with a co-tenant who stays recorded by betas .50–.54 keeps the «fermata del coinquilino» (co-tenant's stop) and stays as it was: if you want it with the plan rule, cancel it from the unit's history and record it again. The beta changes the end of a lease with a co-tenant who stays and the transfers that follow it, the ancillary charges statement, and the stops of transfers that follow one another on the same unit.

CHANGED: THE STOPS SAY THE PART TO BE SETTLED EVEN WHERE THE PROGRAM USED TO SAY NOTHING — After «Scrivi il conguaglio» (write the settlement) at the end of a lease, the part of the days after the exit that the pair gave to whoever sells does not pass by itself to whoever buys: the «Cosa cambierà» (what will change) panel calls it a stop and says the figure and the people. In five cases it said nothing, or said a figure that was no longer the right one. (1) Someone who already has their part of the pair buys another share from someone who did not have it: Ugo holds 75 % and Anna 25 %, the end of Ines's lease writes the settlement, Anna sells to Elsa on 1 October and Elsa sells to Ugo on 1 November. € 15.04 of the days stayed in Anna's row without the program saying so; now the sentence says «€ 15,04 restano a carico di Anna, o di Elsa se la fermata della vendita del 1 ottobre 2026 è già stata regolata» (€ 15.04 stay at Anna's charge, or Elsa's if the stop of the sale of 1 October 2026 has already been settled). If a new tenant then enters (Luca, on 15 December, for 17 days), the stop is reduced by the days of the share only, and € 10.85 remain to be settled. (2) Someone who buys back their own part, and is the only person at whose charge those days are, does not create a new stop, but the second sale says how much is left of the earlier one, with the tick, and the history of the first sale remembers it: Ugo, 100 % owner, sells to Elsa on 1 October (€ 90.74) and Elsa sells back to him on 1 November, and € 30.58 remain. Before, the history still said € 90.74, and whoever followed the sentence from the Wallet made Elsa pay € 60.16 more. A second buy-back and the start of a tenant after a resale say the same, and it holds for the bare owner when the usufruct he had created ends. (3) Bare ownership bought on the day the usufruct ends: Bruno has the full ownership of one half, Ugo the bare ownership of the other and Zeno has its usufruct; Ugo sells the bare ownership to Bruno on 1 October and Zeno's usufruct ends the same day. The days of that half are Bruno's but sit in Zeno's row (€ 45.37), and no stop said so; now «€ 45,37 a carico di Zeno» (€ 45.37 at Zeno's charge), and Bruno's resale divides his part between Bruno's row, with the Wallet, and Zeno's row, without. (4) The succession of someone who had received a stop, when the heir is the only person at whose charge it is: Ugo sells to Elsa on 1 October (€ 90.74), Elsa dies on 15 October and the heir is Ugo. With the arrears in the deceased's name and «Scrivi il conguaglio», Elsa's days up to the death remain to be settled between Ugo and Elsa (€ 13.81); with the arrears to the heirs her position passes to Ugo and nothing is left to settle; with «Non scriverlo» (do not write it) the succession moves nothing. (5) A row opened or changed by hand («Associa soggetto» (associate a person), «Modifica associazione» (edit the association)) without a transfer recorded before: the program does not know in whose row the days of the seller sit, and if several people hold the pair the sentence names none of them, even when one of them is the buyer and no stop arises: it says «La parte di Elsa non viene da un passaggio registrato che dica in quale riga stanno i suoi giorni, e il programma non lo sa.» (Elsa's part does not come from a recorded transfer that says in which row her days sit, and the program does not know.) Before, it named a person who was not involved, or said nothing.

CHANGED: THE END OF A LEASE WITH A CO-TENANT WHO STAYS ASKS WHETHER TO WRITE THE SETTLEMENT, AND CALCULATES IT WITH THE PLAN RULE — When one of the tenants leaves and the other stays, the program did not offer the settlement: the panel declared that who pays the days after the exit is for the parties to decide, and in the transfer's record it wrote a co-tenant's stop. Now, when the plan rule proposes balance rows, the end asks for the choice like the other ends, with the two options «Scrivi il conguaglio» (write the settlement) and «Non scriverlo» (do not write it) and nothing chosen beforehand: «Registra passaggio» (record the transfer) stays off until you choose, and the choice is one for the unit and the ticked appurtenances; if the rule changes nothing, that unit has no pair, and with no pairs there is no choice. The rule is the plan's: the tenant's part that the plan froze is divided again by share and by days among those who were tenants during the year, as in a plan generated after the exit, and the days that no tenant covers go to whoever pays in place of the tenant (the owner, the usufructuary); if no one covers them, not even he, they stay in the instalments of whoever leaves, and the panel says so. An example: an item of € 1,200.00 with 30 % to the tenant, Ines and Dora tenants at 50 %, six instalments issued; Ines leaves on 1 July 2026. In the instalments each has € 180.00; with the plan rule Ines, who is there for 181 days, has € 119.34 and Dora, who is there for 365, € 240.66. With «Scrivi il conguaglio» the balance rows bring each to their part: € 60.66 credit to Ines and € 60.66 debit to Dora. With «Non scriverlo» no balance rows: the instalments stay as they are, and the parties settle the difference among themselves with the ancillary charges statement. A tenant who entered with the start of a lease, or with a change of tenant and «Non scriverlo», on a plan that is no longer recalculated has no shares in the plan and no balance rows: the program does not write a debt for them, says their part with the person and the figure, and it is settled with the statement. Whoever entered with a change of tenant and «Scrivi il conguaglio» has the rows of the change, and the transfers after it write theirs too.

CHANGED: AFTER AN END WITH THE PLAN RULE, THE TRANSFERS ON THE SAME UNIT SAY THEIR OWN PLAN DIFFERENCE — The transfer that comes after an end with the plan rule (the end of another tenant, the change of tenant, the start of a new tenant, a sale), with either choice, starts from what that end left. The end of another tenant writes, like the first end, everyone's difference when everyone can have a balance row; if someone had already left (usually whoever left with the earlier end), or whoever receives the days has no shares in the plan, it writes only the difference of whoever leaves, towards whoever receives their days, and the part that the plan rule would change for the others is not written: the panel says it with the person and the figure and, with «Scrivi il conguaglio», asks for the tick, and the way by hand is the Wallet balances linked to the transfer (if one of those people has neither shares in the plan nor balance rows it is only information, and is settled with the statement). An example: Ugo is the owner, Ines and Dora tenants at 50 %; the end of Ines on 1 July writes the settlement (€ 60.66), then Dora leaves on 1 October and no one stays. Dora's end writes € 78.75 credit to Dora and debit to Ugo (with the day rule it would be € 45.37), and says that Ines's part stays € 11.99 above the plan: € 11.99 credit to Ines and € 11.99 debit to Ugo, to be settled from the Wallet with the balances linked to the transfer. The change of tenant gives whoever enters the difference of whoever leaves. The start of a new tenant, and the end of a tenant with no shares in the plan and no balance rows (who entered with the start of a lease, or with a change of tenant and «Non scriverlo»), write nothing: the panel says the figures of the plan and the statement says who reimburses whom (Luca's start on 1 September at 50 %: Luca € 65.75, Dora € 196.71 and Ines € 97.54; Luca reimburses € 43.95 to Dora and € 21.80 to Ines with the ancillary charges statement). Someone who had already left earlier, because all their tenant rows had ended before the day of the transfer, does not receive a balance row from the end of another tenant: if their part changes, the panel says it. An end with a co-tenant who stays recorded by betas .50–.54, without the choice, stays as it was: where no other co-tenant stays the transfers after it follow the day rule, and where one stays the end after it writes nothing, not even the pair of whoever leaves, and the panel says the plan rule starting from the instalments of then, with the people and the figures, and says to cancel the earlier end from the unit's history and record it again (if the later end already exists, it is cancelled first: the history says so).

CHANGED: THE ANCILLARY CHARGES STATEMENT SAYS THE PLAN RULE, ALSO ON THE PLANS OF 1.10 — Where the lease continued with a co-tenant, the statement divides with the plan rule the items that a transfer changed (an item that no transfer changed stays as it is in the instalments), by share and by days over the whole item, and next to each tenant says what they have in their instalments, what a transfer wrote in balances («con il conguaglio della fine locazione del …» (with the settlement of the end of the lease of …)) and, with the name and the transfer, who reimburses whom. In the example of Ines and Dora the statement gives Ines € 119.34 (€ 180.00 in her instalments, less € 60.66 credit to her with the settlement) and Dora € 240.66 (€ 180.00 plus € 60.66); with «Non scriverlo» instead of the settlement it says Dora reimburses € 60.66 to Ines. The same holds for a budget generated by 1.10, which has no recorded allocation: the statement reads it with the shares of the instalments. For those plans, if a tenant also has another role on the unit (for instance buys a share of ownership after the end), the tenant's part no longer separates and the plan rule is not recalculated: the statement leaves that plan out and says why, with the figures of the end. For the ends recorded by betas .50–.54 the statement stays on the day rule, and says the Wallet balances linked to that end.

CHANGED: AFTER A STOP, THE STATEMENT AND THE START OF A TENANT SAY WHO PAID THE DAYS OF THE SHARE — When a sale has left a person a share that sits in someone else's row, the days of that share were not paid by whoever received the sale. Ugo holds 75 % and Anna 25 %; Anna sells to Elsa on 1 October, Elsa sells to Ugo on 1 November and Luca enters on 15 December: the panel and the statement made Luca reimburse Ugo all 17 days (€ 16.77), but € 4.19 belong to the share bought, whose days sit in Anna's row. Now the panel says that Luca reimburses Ugo and Anna, and the statement divides Luca's item among those who paid it: € 12.58 Ugo and € 4.19 Anna (Elsa or Ugo, in place of Anna, if the parties have settled the stops). It also holds beyond a succession to the heirs: the share is followed into the heirs' rows.

FIX: THE CHANGE-OF-TENANT STATEMENT NO LONGER SPLITS THE DAYS OF WHOEVER LEAVES WITH THOSE WHO DID NOT TAKE THEM — The ancillary charges statement is the document with which the parties reimburse each other when you choose «Non scriverlo», and three cases got it wrong from beta.50. (1) Ines and Luca tenants at 50 %, an item of € 1,200.00 with 30 % to the tenant; Ines leaves on 1 July and Sara enters with «Non scriverlo»: the statement made Luca share Sara's days too, so Luca had € 225.37 (€ 180.00 in his instalments) and Sara € 45.37. Now Luca has € 180.00 and nothing to reimburse, and Sara € 90.74, as the panel and the record say. (2) With a second change: Luca leaves on 1 April and Ivo enters, Ines leaves on 1 July and Irma enters, both with «Non scriverlo»; Irma paid € 145.11 and Ivo € 81.25, and now Irma € 90.74 and Ivo € 135.62. Whoever enters with the start of a lease, and so took no one's place, shares as before. (3) After a change with «Scrivi il conguaglio», whoever entered afterwards with a start had no section in the statement, and whoever had entered with the change was left with all the days of whoever had left: Ines, alone at 80 %, leaves on 1 July and Sara enters (€ 181.48), then Teo enters on 1 September at 20 %. The panel said that Teo reimburses Sara «con il prospetto» (with the statement), and the statement did not have Teo. Now Sara has € 155.68 and Teo € 25.80, «pagata da Sara» (paid by Sara); it also holds for whoever had left and comes back.

FIX: THE HEAD OF THE STATEMENT DOES NOT SAY «EMPTY» WHEN AN APPROVED PLAN HAS BEEN LEFT OUT — A budget generated by 1.10, with the holders changed after generation (a change of tenant, a start), left the statement, and the print said at the head «Nessun piano rate approvato in questo esercizio: il prospetto è vuoto.» (no instalment plan approved in this financial year: the statement is empty) and at the bottom «Nessuna voce a carico dell'inquilino» (no item at the tenant's charge), while the plan was approved and had € 360.00 at the tenant's charge. Now, when no plan can be read, the head says which approved plan was left out and why, and the print that its items are not reported.

FIX: THE SENTENCES OF SUCCESSIONS AND OF RESIDUES SAY THE RIGHT FIGURES — (1) Two successions in a row with the arrears to the heirs: Mario and Anna at 50 %, Mario dies on 1 October (heir Ugo), Ugo dies on 15 October (heir Bruno). The second wrote «€ 38,47 restano a carico di Ugo» (€ 38.47 stay at Ugo's charge), with the Wallet, while the same panel said that Ugo's arrears pass to Bruno: following the sentence, Bruno paid twice. Now the succession to the heirs in a row does not make the heir's stop, and if Bruno resells the stop is at his charge with the Wallet, with no credit to a dead person. (2) With the arrears in the deceased's name and «Non scriverlo», the resale of the heir who had also bought put the whole figure at the charge of whoever had sold to him: Ugo 75 %, Anna 25 %, Anna sells to Bruno, Ugo dies and leaves to Bruno and Elsa, Bruno resells; € 19.11 were «a carico di Anna» (at Anna's charge) and now «a carico di Ugo e Anna, o di Bruno se la parte di Bruno è già stata regolata» (at the charge of Ugo and Anna, or of Bruno if Bruno's part has already been settled), because € 11.47 come from the inherited part, in Ugo's row. (3) The part that the deceased had received with a stop passes to the heir, but the heir's resale did not see it: Ugo sells the full half to Bruno, Zeno's usufruct ends, Ugo dies and his half goes to Bruno, who resells everything. Now «€ 30,58 restano a carico di Zeno e Bruno» (€ 30.58 stay at the charge of Zeno and Bruno), without the Wallet, and no longer all at Bruno's charge. (4) The succession to the heirs of someone who had also bought a share with a stop (Mario dies on 1 October, Anna sells to Ugo on 5 October, Ugo dies on 15 October, always with the arrears to the heirs) said «€ 57,70 restano a carico di Ugo e Anna» (€ 57.70 stay at the charge of Ugo and Anna); what is to be said is Anna's share alone, € 19.23, because the part received from Mario passes with the position. (5) The sentence that says the part passed with a succession names all the people who had it («Mario e Ugo hanno preso € 181,48» (Mario and Ugo took € 181.48)), and in the sentences of the start of a tenant the names of whoever took the days after the exit are said once only (not «Ugo e Anna e Ugo»), with the heirs in place of the deceased. (6) The unit's history no longer offers «Annulla il conguaglio» (cancel the settlement) where the command would refuse it, because a succession took a row of that pair: it says the way (first the succession, then the settlement; a sale recorded afterwards is cancelled first and recorded again).

THE GUIDES — The guide «Guida: registrare un passaggio» (guide: recording a transfer) says the choice and the plan rule where the lease continues with a co-tenant, the transfers after (each says its own plan difference), the ancillary charges statement with the plan rule, and the new stops (the buy-back, the bare ownership that becomes full when the usufruct ends, the succession of someone who had received, rows opened by hand). It no longer says that with a co-tenant the program does not offer the settlement.

HOW IT WORKS TODAY, WHERE IT MAKES A DIFFERENCE — (1) Transfers already recorded from beta.50 to beta.54 are not corrected by themselves: a stop, an end with a co-tenant who stays and the sales recorded after keep in their record what was written then, and the transfers you record after them read it as it is. If the transfer is the last one on the unit and the history lets you cancel it, cancel it and record it again; otherwise correct the linked rows from the Wallet. (2) A stop at the charge of several people recorded before beta.53 does not have the people in its record: the sale that follows still puts it at the charge of the whole pair. (3) After a change of tenant with «Non scriverlo» and a second change, the end of the co-tenant who stayed says who reimburses whom only for the first: Ines leaves on 1 July and Sara enters, Sara leaves on 1 September and Teo enters, then Luca leaves on 1 October; the end and the statement say «Sara rimborsa a Ines € 90,74» (Sara reimburses Ines € 90.74), while Sara owes € 30.58 and Teo € 60.16. The totals per person are right. (4) If the rows of someone who had already received a stop are changed by hand, the resale may say «€ 60,16 restano a carico di Anna» (€ 60.16 stay at Anna's charge) while € 45.12 sit in Ugo's row; the figure per person is missing in some chains and in the sentences of the start of a tenant after a divided stop. (5) The change of tenant of a tenant with no shares in the plan says nothing, while the plan rule divides their part between whoever enters and the tenants who stay; the statement is right. (6) After a change of tenant, the direction of the sentence of the start of a tenant comes from the days and not from the shares: with an income of only the months of whoever enters that slightly exceeds the expense (in the example of Ines alone at 80 % and Teo from 1 September at 20 %, between € 401.10 and € 430.00) the sentence may say «Sara restituisce la differenza a Teo» (Sara returns the difference to Teo) while the statement gives Teo up to € 1.73 to reimburse to Sara. (7) With two changes in a row the same stories give different figures per person between «Scrivi il conguaglio» and «Non scriverlo» (Sara € 6.06, Pia € 5.25 and Teo € 0.81 in the example). (8) The record of the change of tenant written by betas .50–.54 does not have the figures unit by unit: with appurtenances the statement rebuilds them, and may be off by one or two cents.
